threads.body: `expected_spans` uses `interactions.create`, but the weaver policy enforces `gen_ai.operation.name` to be one of the documented enum values; `interactions.create` will trigger a `genai_operation_name_unknown` violation and fail `run_conformance`. Either update the instrumentation to emit a semconv operation like `chat`, or (at minimum) declare this as an `expected_violations` entry so the conformance suite can run without unexpected violations.
